d: Short, messy platinum white hair with long bangs framing the face. Sharp, narrow eyes of a glowing golden-yellow hue, paired with a youthful, adolescent facial appearance. A slender build wearing a black military-style jacket with gold embroidery and red accents on the shoulders, black trousers, and a silver-buckled belt. A floating, glowing purple ring hovers above the head, while a large black sword with a gold hilt is held in the hand.
